# Error catalogue

Every error is an [RFC 7807](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807) problem document with media type `application/problem+json`, a `type` URI from the list below, a `title`, the HTTP `status`, and a `detail` an end user can read. A problem whose shape matches but whose `type` or status differs from what is listed here is behaviourally wrong: the client keys on the `type`, not the text. A generic 400 where a specific type is listed is a bug.

## 409 That time is no longer available

`https://midvaal.example/problems/slot-conflict`

- **When:** A booking is submitted, or a move requested, for a window that is no longer free on any day it covers. Includes a day taken by a related facility.
- **Extension members:** `conflictingWindow` (the part no longer free), `relatedFacility` (when the block comes from a parent or child), `reason` (in words).
- **What the client does:** Keeps every answer on the form, explains which time and why, names the related facility, and offers the calendar with the draft carried back.
- **Operations:** `submitBooking`, `rescheduleBooking`

## 409 Already decided

`https://midvaal.example/problems/already-decided`

- **When:** An approver decides a work item that someone else has already decided.
- **Extension members:** `decision` (`outcome`, `decidedBy`, `decidedAt`).
- **What the client does:** Says who decided it, what they decided and when, and refreshes the item. Keeps the text the approver wrote.
- **Operations:** `approveBooking`, `rejectBooking`, `approveRescheduleRequest`, `rejectRescheduleRequest`

## 409 That is not allowed

`https://midvaal.example/problems/action-not-allowed`

- **When:** A cancellation or move the rules do not allow; approving a request an approved booking already stands in the way of; removing a role or deactivating an account a guard rail protects.
- **Extension members:** `code` for the guard rails: `own_system_administrator_role`, `last_system_administrator`, `self`. The `detail` is the reason, in words.
- **What the client does:** Shows the reason. For the guard rails the interface has already declined to offer the action, using `protections`, so this is the backstop.
- **Operations:** `cancelBooking`, `rescheduleBooking`, `approveBooking`, `approveRescheduleRequest`, `changeUserRole`, `deactivateUser`

## 422 Validation failed

`https://midvaal.example/problems/validation-failed`

- **When:** A request body is understood but a field is not acceptable.
- **Extension members:** `errors`: messages keyed by the name of the field at fault (for a list, `field.index`).
- **What the client does:** Puts each message on its field, moves focus to the first, and keeps what the person typed.
- **Operations:** 39 of the 87 (every operation that takes a path identifier, a body or a query, as applicable).

## 409 The batch was not saved

`https://midvaal.example/problems/batch-not-saved`

- **When:** An allocation batch passed validation but failed while being applied. Everything has been put back.
- **Extension members:** None. `detail` names the facility at fault.
- **What the client does:** Keeps every pending edit, says nothing was saved, and names the facility.
- **Operations:** `saveAllocationBatch`, `saveFacilityAllocations`

## 404 Not found

`https://midvaal.example/problems/not-found`

- **When:** No such record; or one the caller must not be able to tell exists (another applicant’s booking, a work item outside the approver’s scope).
- **Extension members:** None.
- **What the client does:** Shows a not found state. Never distinguishes "does not exist" from "not yours".
- **Operations:** 56 of the 87 (every operation that takes a path identifier, a body or a query, as applicable).

## 403 Forbidden

`https://midvaal.example/problems/forbidden`

- **When:** The caller is signed in but their role does not allow the operation (a facility administrator calling a system administrator route).
- **Extension members:** None.
- **What the client does:** The interface already hides what the role cannot reach; this is the backstop.

## 401 No valid session

`https://midvaal.example/problems/unauthenticated`

- **When:** The token is missing, expired or not valid.
- **Extension members:** None.
- **What the client does:** Sends the person to sign in.

## 400 Invalid query

`https://midvaal.example/problems/invalid-query`

- **When:** A query parameter is malformed, unknown to the endpoint, or outside what it allows.
- **Extension members:** None. `detail` names the parameter.
- **What the client does:** A bug in the client, not a case it handles. Shown as a general failure.
- **Operations:** `listFacilities`, `getAvailability`, `listBookings`, `getBookingsSummary`, `listApprovals`, `listAdminFacilities`, `listResources`, `getAllocationMatrix`, `listUsers`, `listAudit`, `exportAudit`

## 409 Conflict

`https://midvaal.example/problems/conflict`

- **When:** A state conflict that none of the above covers: changing an archived record, editing a published terms version (`code: terms_immutable`), publishing a version that is not a draft (`code: terms_not_draft`).
- **Extension members:** `code`, where one is documented.
- **What the client does:** Shows the `detail`.
- **Operations:** 20 of the 87 (every operation that takes a path identifier, a body or a query, as applicable).

## 500 Internal error

`https://midvaal.example/problems/internal-error`

- **When:** The service failed. Any 5xx.
- **Extension members:** None.
- **What the client does:** Shows a general failure with a retry; a failed save keeps what was entered.
